finite_temperature_route_audit.old_lower_bound: delta_beta=theta_Q tanh(x_beta)/x_beta-I3/(2 beta c), x_beta tanh(x_beta)=beta hbar^2/(4 chi theta_Q)

ground_equal_time_order.objects: D_beta,L(p)=(Qhat_p,Qhat_-p)_D, C_beta,L(p)=<Qhat_p Qhat_-p>, K_beta,L(p)=<[Qhat_p,[beta H_L,Qhat_-p]]>=beta hbar^2/chi
ground_equal_time_order.infrared_substitution: For p!=0, D_beta,L(p)<=[2 beta c E(p)]^(-1), hence C_beta,L(p)<=hbar/[2 sqrt(2 chi c E(p))] coth[beta hbar sqrt(cE(p)/(2chi))].
ground_equal_time_order.ground_cap: At fixed L and beta->infinity, C_0,L(p)<=hbar/[2 sqrt(2 chi c E(p))] for p!=0.
ground_equal_time_order.half_Watson: J3=(2pi)^(-3) integral d^3p/sqrt(E(p))=0.643953733381468096... and J3^2<=I3 by normalized Cauchy--Schwarz.
ground_equal_time_order.order_density: m_L^2=<S_L^2>_0,L/V^2; Fourier inversion and <Q_0^2>_0,L>=theta_Q give liminf_(L->infinity)m_L^2>=rho_*=theta_Q-hbar J3/[2sqrt(2chi c)]=hbar[sqrt(A0)-J3]/sqrt(8chi c)>0. The intrinsic condition is A0>J3^2; normalized Cauchy J3^2<=I3 shows that EXP-000782's A0>I3 regime is contained in it.
ground_equal_time_order.unbounded_observable_passage: Finite-L compact resolvent and quartic confinement give beta-to-infinity convergence and uniform integrability of the required quadratic observables; translation-invariant ground-energy-density bounds give the local moment control used for subsequential bounded-observable states.
ground_equal_time_order.boundary: This is fixed-spacing, equal-time, symmetric-ground long-range order in the iterated beta-first limit. It is not yet two distinct ground states of a common infinite-volume dynamics.

approximate_doublets_and_gap.ground_parity: The finite-volume ground vector Omega_L is unique, translation invariant and even.
approximate_doublets_and_gap.odd_trial: Phi_L=S_L Omega_L/||S_L Omega_L|| is normalized and odd.
approximate_doublets_and_gap.odd_gap_bound: Delta_L^odd<=hbar^2/[2 chi V m_L^2]. Therefore Delta_L^full<=Delta_L^odd and limsup_L V Delta_L^full<=hbar^2/(2chi rho_*); no positive volume-uniform full gap exists.
approximate_doublets_and_gap.broken_candidates: Psi_L^plus/minus=(Omega_L plus/minus Phi_L)/sqrt(2) are translation invariant, have <Q_y>=plus/minus sqrt(m_L^2), and total-energy excess at most hbar^2/[4chi V m_L^2].
approximate_doublets_and_gap.boundary: Locally compact subsequences give distinct symmetry-broken zero-temperature approximate-ground candidates with vanishing total-energy excess. Calling them algebraic ground states requires a common infinite-volume dynamics and ground-state condition. The result does not rule out a positive excitation gap inside either broken GNS sector.

continuum_counterterm_audit.lattice_spacing_boundary: EXP-000780--EXP-000782 and EXP-000789 use spacing one. No a-dependent Hamiltonian, field normalization, bare-parameter flow or a-uniform state estimate has yet been declared.
continuum_counterterm_audit.quartic: W4=(g/4)sum_e q_e^4+(lambda/4)sum_(e~f)(q_e-q_f)^2(q_e^2+q_f^2), with 12 undirected Q3 edges and L_Q3=3I-A.
continuum_counterterm_audit.quadratic_requirement: Even the first contraction needs independent I and L_Q3 quadratic counterterm directions plus a scalar counterterm; reversing the raw/Wick convention changes signs, not the required directions.
continuum_counterterm_audit.one_loop_polynomial: T(q)=tr[(W4''(q))^2]. For Q3 vertices e,f at Hamming distance two, [q_e^2 q_f^2]T=4lambda^2, while the original g,lambda quartic span contains no such monomial.
continuum_counterterm_audit.no_go: For lambda>0 the original two-invariant quartic basis is not closed under the standard local 3+1D one-loop counterterm test. At least the distance-two invariant sum_(d(e,f)=2)q_e^2q_f^2, and safely the full Aut(Q3) times Z2 invariant quartic tensor basis, must be admitted and tested.
continuum_counterterm_audit.boundary: This does not refute an enlarged renormalized trajectory, lambda(a)->0, nonperturbative cancellation, another regulator or another UV parent. The nonzero regulator-specific logarithmic coefficient and a-uniform constructive limit remain to be proved.
